name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.4 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 5 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 13 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2025-07-14, at wavelengths from 1.31 to 4.10 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
